title: The Lantern Delivery
premise: A small fox carries one lantern across a stream to welcome a lost moth home.
ending: The moth settles beside the glowing lantern while the fox waves goodbye.
style_bible: Soft cut-paper illustration, deep indigo dusk, warm amber lantern, restrained cream highlights. Stable shapes and visible contact. Do not introduce text or extra props.

characters.description: Small cream fox with triangular ears, a single teal scarf, dark oval eyes and one cream tail. Scarf knot on the left.
characters.initial_state: Standing to the left of a closed wooden crate.

characters.description: One small amber moth with two rounded patterned wings.
characters.initial_state: Absent until the light is switched on.

props.description: One small brass lantern with an arched handle and one warm bulb.
One plain wooden crate with a hinged lid.

shots.action: Fox notices a wooden crate and bends toward it.
shots.start: Fox stands beside the closed crate.
shots.end: Fox crouches with both paws near the lid.

shots.state: One closed crate on the ground.

shots.action: Fox lifts the crate lid once.
shots.end: Lid is open and one unlit lantern is visible.
shots.camera: Locked medium three-quarter view for this action; preserve left-to-right geography. Design deliberate camera changes between locations.

shots.action: Fox grips the handle and lifts out the lantern.
shots.start: Lantern rests inside the open crate.
shots.end: Fox stands holding the unlit lantern at waist height.
shots.camera: Locked medium three-quarter view for this action; preserve left-to-right geography. Design deliberate camera changes between locations.
shots.state: One lantern, both paws on its handle.

shots.start: Lantern is off in the fox paws.
shots.camera: Locked medium three-quarter view for this action; preserve left-to-right geography. Design deliberate camera changes between locations.
shots.state: One paw steadies the handle; the other touches the switch.

shots.action: A moth flies into view and circles the light once.
shots.camera: Locked medium three-quarter view for this action; preserve left-to-right geography. Design deliberate camera changes between locations.
shots.state: One moth, one lantern, fox remains still.

shots.action: Moth turns toward the far bank and fox follows its gaze.
shots.end: Both face the stream to screen right.
shots.camera: Locked medium three-quarter view for this action; preserve left-to-right geography. Design deliberate camera changes between locations.
shots.state: Lantern remains held; crate stays behind.

shots.action: Fox takes a few careful steps toward the stream.
shots.start: Fox faces screen right with lantern.
shots.end: Fox stops at the near bank.
shots.camera: Locked medium three-quarter view for this action; preserve left-to-right geography. Design deliberate camera changes between locations.
shots.state: Do not swap the lantern between paws during the walk.

shots.action: Fox tests a stepping stone with one foot.
shots.end: One foot rests on the near stepping stone.
shots.camera: Locked medium three-quarter view for this action; preserve left-to-right geography. Design deliberate camera changes between locations.
shots.state: Lantern held clear of water; planted foot remains on bank.

shots.action: Fox shifts weight and steps fully onto the stone.
shots.start: One foot is on the stone.
shots.end: Both feet balance on the stone.
shots.camera: Locked medium three-quarter view for this action; preserve left-to-right geography. Design deliberate camera changes between locations.
shots.state: Lantern stays upright; show foot contact.

shots.action: Fox steps from the stone onto the far bank.
shots.start: Both feet are on the stone.
shots.end: Fox stands safely on the far bank.
shots.camera: Locked medium three-quarter view for this action; preserve left-to-right geography. Design deliberate camera changes between locations.
shots.state: One lantern remains held; moth follows.

shots.action: Fox lowers the lantern beside a hollow tree.

shots.end: Lantern rests on the ground; paws release its handle.
shots.camera: Locked medium three-quarter view for this action; preserve left-to-right geography. Design deliberate camera changes between locations.
shots.state: One lantern grounded beside the tree opening.

shots.action: Moth descends and lands beside the warm lantern.
shots.start: Moth hovers above the grounded lantern.
shots.end: Moth rests at the tree opening.

shots.action: Fox lifts one paw in a small farewell wave.
shots.start: Fox stands near the lantern and settled moth.
shots.end: Fox lowers the paw after one wave.
shots.camera: Locked medium three-quarter view for this action; preserve left-to-right geography. Design deliberate camera changes between locations.

shots.action: Fox turns and walks out of frame while the lantern lights the home.
shots.end: Fox has left; moth rests beside the glowing lantern.
